task.title: Thanksgiving-week holiday hours rollout, Pacific stores
task.objective: Publish Thanksgiving-week holiday hours (closed Thursday, 6am-10pm Friday, normal hours otherwise) at the Pacific stores, then notify each store's manager exactly once. Spokane (GEG) needs overtime approval AR-30918 for employee E-4471 first. Boise (BOI) stays untouched until the user confirms.
task.outcome: Hours published and each manager notified exactly once at PDX, SEA, TAC, EUG, SLE, BND, OLM. The Spokane schedule is published only after AR-30918 is approved. BOI is handled only as the user directs.

success_criteria.description: Holiday hours published at PDX, SEA, TAC, EUG, SLE, BND, OLM.
Each published store's manager notified exactly once.
Spokane schedule not published before AR-30918 is approved.
BOI not changed without user confirmation.

completed.description: Listed the nine Pacific stores. All showed holiday_hours 'not published' at that time.
Requested overtime approval for E-4471 at GEG. The system returned AR-30918 with status pending.
publish_holiday_hours succeeded for PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND, OLM. This includes GEG, which was published before AR-30918 was approved; see q-geg-publish.
Manager notices sent to PDX, SEA, TAC. Do not resend them.

focus.description: Sending manager notices when the backend connection was lost. Notices for GEG, EUG, SLE, BND, OLM failed, and two get_approval checks of AR-30918 also failed.

next.description: Tell the user that GEG holiday hours were published before AR-30918 was approved, which may break their instruction. The earlier summary did not say this. Ask how they want GEG handled.
Once the backend is reachable, send the holiday-hours notice once each to the EUG, SLE, BND and OLM managers.

Settle the GEG manager notice and the Spokane schedule after the user answers q-geg-publish and the AR-30918 status is known. The drafted GEG notice says the Spokane schedule will be published once approved, which may be untrue now.
Do nothing at BOI until the user confirms.

statements.text: A schedule that puts an employee into overtime may be published only after the store manager approves it (request_overtime_approval, then get_approval).
Roll out Thanksgiving-week holiday hours (closed Thursday, 6am-10pm Friday, normal hours otherwise) to all nine Pacific stores. Publish each store's hours, then notify its manager, once each.
First request overtime approval for E-4471 at Spokane (GEG), who is needed to cover the extended Friday close. Do not publish the Spokane schedule until that is approved.
Leave Boise (BOI) alone until the user confirms. It is mid-renovation and may be closed all week.
publish_holiday_hours returned success for PDX, SEA, TAC, GEG, EUG, SLE, BND, OLM. BOI was not published.
notify_manager returned 'Message sent' for PDX, SEA, TAC.
notify_manager for GEG, EUG, SLE, BND, OLM returned 'Error: the session has ended (connection to the backend lost). No action was taken.'
AR-30918 was pending when it was created. Both later get_approval calls failed with the backend-lost error, so its current status is unknown.
The store-operations backend connection was lost at the boundary. Every call after the third notice failed.

No tool separate from publish_holiday_hours was seen for publishing a Spokane schedule. Publishing GEG holiday hours (6am-10pm Friday, which needs E-4471's overtime) may therefore be the publication the user and operator policy said to hold until AR-30918 is approved. If so, it was published too early.

GEG holiday hours were published while AR-30918 was pending. Should they stay as published, or be withdrawn or held until approval? Is there a separate Spokane staff schedule still to publish? The user has not been told this yet.
What should happen at Boise (BOI): holiday hours, closed all week, or something else? Awaiting user confirmation.

preconditions.description: The store-operations backend responds to a read-only call (for example list_stores) before any write.
Re-check the stores' published state with list_stores and confirm GEG's current state before acting.

stop_conditions.description: Do not publish or change anything at BOI without explicit user confirmation.
Do not resend notices to the PDX, SEA or TAC managers; they were already notified.
Do not publish or change the Spokane schedule unless get_approval shows AR-30918 approved in the system, or the user directs otherwise about the already-published GEG hours.

recovery.description: Tell the user that GEG holiday hours were published before AR-30918 was approved, and ask how to proceed.
Once the backend is up, check AR-30918 with get_approval.
Send the EUG, SLE, BND and OLM notices once each.
Send the GEG notice with wording that matches the actual state, after the user answers.
